title: Donna A NDE 706
content: I can remember being scared to have the operation. During the surgery, I almost died and I can remember rising out of my body a few feet and all I was interested in seeing was my mother. I did notice a great big huge light coming from above me. I couldn't tell if this was a surgery light or if it came from elsewhere. I floated through doorways and didn't pay any attention to the surgical goings on. The main thing that I was interested in was comforting my mother. I remember that she was with a couple of her friends. I wanted so very badly just to be able to reach out and hold her. I can remember being there with them; of course, they had no idea. Suddenly I was snapped away, something must have happened in the operating room, and I was whisked back into my body. After my operation and throughout the rest of my childhood I became an adult. I had no childhood really and I was always there to help my mother. (I think this was even stronger since her family was in England.)

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related Life threatening event, but not clinical death I had a brain tumor and it was being surgically removed/attempted. It involved the brain and other things in that area. It was a craneo-pharyngioma. I have actually had three major brain operations for this tumor.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I had no appearance at all. I saw a mass of light, but not real bright that was in my place.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was very alert and knew and understood all that was going on.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Uncertain I saw a light I was just unsure where it came from.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I knew that I had a purpose that was yet to be fulfilled. I also know that I have not yet gotten there either.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I was no longer afraid of death at all. I knew that I had a purpose to serve and I couldn't quit before I reached that. I had a closeness with my mother that I cannot put in words, but that was important because she needed that and especially since I had taken on an adult like role.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain It was very emotional for me. I find anything emotional hard to explain.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes After this, and it continued to grow, I found that I did have a few psychic abilities. But they were limited.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part of this experience was being able to comfort. The worst part I think was when I was suddenly snatched away from it.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Uncertain More surgeries which led to it?
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: Was your experience with living people or deceased ones? Mine was with the living.
